title: 第十二章  我只是来吃饭的
content_zh:
陈木吓了一跳，没想到苏林依灵觉这么高，陈木早上的样子已经用真气遮掩住了，普通人根本无法发现他是谁，就算是赚的苏林依的四万块钱都已经存进了银行卡，那个放钱的黑袋子早就扔了，陈木可没有这么傻，一个人拿着四万块钱招摇过市。

    “没有。”陈木自然不想让苏林依认出他，倒不是陈木怕苏林依，而是苏林依一旦知道自己的本事后，或许会生出很多不必要的麻烦，现在的陈木只想安心修炼提升实力，不想生出太多的麻烦。

    “哦。”苏林依见陈木这么说，而且表情也很自然，也就没有太多的怀疑，压下心中的疑惑，之后也不理陈木了，毕竟那个小屋虽然小了点，但里面的设施还是比较齐全的。

    苏林依拉着孙依诗进了别墅，然后将阿黄放了出来，看门口，她确实有点怕陈木偷看她，毕竟现在还不了解陈木，自我防范意识强点总比吃亏的好。

    陈木这才知道，原来阿黄是苏林依养的一条狗，苏林依见到陈木盯着阿黄看了几眼，以为陈木有点害怕，不过阿黄如果没人招惹它的话，也不会随便咬人。

    见到苏林依两女进了别墅，陈木这才有功夫走近那株银叶草旁边，感受着其上的灵气，心中一喜，喃喃道：“这株银叶草已经成熟了，看来过不了多久，可以凝结出很多银叶草种子。”

    至于阿黄看到陈木走近那些花草，根本不敢动一下，显然是感受到了眼前的这人不是好惹的，不过见到陈木没有想进别墅的意思，便自顾自的趴在那边打呼噜睡觉了。

    陈木观察了一会其他的花草，发现出了这株银叶草，没有其他灵草了，也就直接进去小木屋，准备打坐修炼。

    虽然这个星球的灵气十分少，本来已经接近放弃修炼的陈木，发现了银叶草后，又期待了起来，能够提升实力，陈木自然不会放过这样的机会，况且只有自身的实力强大，才能让陈木感受到安全感。

    小木屋虽然很小，但里面的设施却很齐全，竟然还有个单独的卫生间，这让陈木突然感觉到这才是有钱人的生活啊，这身体的前主人，虽然贵为陈家子弟，似乎生活条件很一般，晚上也大多数住在大学宿舍里。根本无法跟苏林依或者孙依诗相比。

    …..

    别墅里面，苏林依从窗外看着灯亮着的园丁小木屋，心里不知道想什么，总感觉有些别扭，对着孙依诗说道：“小诗，别墅突然多了一个陌生男生出来，感觉好别扭啊，你说老爸为什么要将这个人安排在我身边？”
content_en:
Chen Mu was startled. He didn't expect that Su Linyi's spiritual consciousness was so high. Chen Mu's appearance in the morning had been covered with his true energy. Ordinary people couldn't find out who he was. Even the 40,000 yuan Su Linyi earned had been deposited into his bank card. The black bag where the money was put had been thrown away long ago. Chen Mu was not that stupid, swaggering through the market with 40,000 yuan alone.

"No." Chen Mu naturally didn't want Su Linyi to recognize him. It wasn't that Chen Mu was afraid of Su Linyi, but that once Su Linyi knew his abilities, he might cause a lot of unnecessary trouble. Now Chen Mu just wanted to practice and improve his strength in peace, and didn't want to cause too many troubles.

"Oh." Su Linyi saw that Chen Mu said this and his expression was very natural, so he didn't have too many doubts. He suppressed the doubts in his heart and ignored Chen Mu. After all, although the cabin was a bit small, the facilities inside were still relatively complete.

Su Linyi pulled Sun Yishi into the villa, and then let Ah Huang out. Looking at the door, she was really a little afraid that Chen Mu would peek at her. After all, she didn't know Chen Mu yet, so it was better to be more self-aware than to suffer a loss.

Only then did Chen Mu know that A-Huang was a dog raised by Su Linyi. Su Linyi saw Chen Mu staring at A-Huang a few times, thinking that Chen Mu was a little scared, but A-Huang would not bite anyone casually if no one provoked it.

Seeing Su Linyi and the two girls entering the villa, Chen Mu had the time to approach the silver-leaf grass. Feeling the aura on it, he felt happy and murmured: "This silver-leaf grass has matured. It seems that it won't be long before it can condense a lot of silver-leaf grass seeds."

As for Ah Huang, when he saw Chen Mu approaching the flowers and plants, he didn't dare to move at all. He obviously felt that the person in front of him was not easy to mess with. However, seeing that Chen Mu had no intention of entering the villa, he just lay there and snored to sleep.

Chen Mu observed other flowers and plants for a while and found out that there was this silver-leaf grass. There were no other spiritual grasses, so he went directly into the cabin and prepared to meditate.

Although there is very little spiritual energy on this planet, Chen Mu, who was on the verge of giving up on cultivation, discovered Silver Leaf Grass and began to look forward to improving his strength. Chen Mu naturally would not let go of such an opportunity. Moreover, only his own strength can make Chen Mu feel safe.

Although the cabin was small, the facilities inside were very complete, and there was even a separate bathroom. This made Chen Mu suddenly feel that this was the life of the rich. Although the previous owner of this body was a descendant of the Chen family, his living conditions seemed to be very ordinary, and he mostly lived in university dormitories at night.There is no way to compare with Su Linyi or Sun Yishi.

…..

Inside the villa, Su Linyi looked at the gardener's cabin with the lights on from the window. She didn't know what she was thinking. She always felt a little awkward. She said to Sun Yishi: "Xiao Shi, a strange boy suddenly came out of the villa. It feels so awkward. Why do you think dad arranged this person next to me?"
title_en: Chapter 12 I’m just here to eat
